name: Pick Your Poison
summary: A party game of creating horrible would-you-rather dilemmas and guessing which option the majority will pick.
rules_text: All players hold six Poison cards and Pick cards A/B plus one Double Down. One player is Judge each round. Judge plays a Poison card as option A. Each other player submits one Poison card face down to the Judge. Judge reads them and chooses one as option B; its submitter scores 1. Pickers may ask the Judge to clarify or embellish the two scenarios. Then each Picker simultaneously chooses A or B with their Pick card face down, optionally adding Double Down to score double or lose it forever if they score zero. Cards are revealed. If all Pickers pick the same option, each Picker scores 1 and Judge loses 2. If the vote splits, majority Pickers score 1 each (2 with Double Down). If tied, Judge scores 3 and Pickers 0. Discard A and B, retrieve Picks, draw to six Poison cards, and rotate Judge left. First to 15 points wins.
rating_reason: Majority vote hidden choice, simultaneous pick, pure strategic reasoning
